project_name: Switch Tahoe Reno / The Citadel Campus
aliases: Tahoe Reno Exascale Data Center Ecosystem
status_detail: Switch's official Tahoe Reno page describes The Citadel campus at Tahoe Reno as an exascale data center ecosystem with gigawatt-scale power capacity upon completion. Storey County's official 2015 statement described Switch's announced $1 billion, 3 million sq ft SUPERNAP data center; public summaries report the campus opened in 2017 with 130 MW and plans for about 650 MW on a 2,000-acre site.
notes: Capacity is full-build estimate from public reporting/tracker context; official Switch page states gigawatt-scale rather than a single MW number.

aliases: Google Storey County, Nevada Data Center
status_detail: Google's official data center locations page identifies an operating Storey County, Nevada data center. TRIC site notes Google arrived at Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center after buying 1,210 acres for a data center; tracker data lists Google's Storey County Building 1 as operational in 2021 with 101 MW.
notes: Official Google source confirms location; capacity/building-year from tracker.

aliases: Peru Shelf Technology Park Data Center
status_detail: Tract's official Peru Shelf page says the Storey County technology park is owned/in development, covers 686 acres in TRIC, and has 810 MW capacity. Tract's 2024 official release says it broke ground on the master-planned data center development; Baxtel describes it as under construction with planned 2028 timing.
notes: This is a data center park/infrastructure development; individual tenant campuses may be separate rows.

project_name: Fleet Peru Shelf Tech Park / SV RNO Property Owner 1
aliases: SV RNO Property Owner 1 LLC data center
status_detail: Storey County minutes acknowledge SV RNO Property Owner 1 LLC's GOED data center tax abatement application for operations planned in Storey County. Cahill's financing notice says SV RNO is an indirect subsidiary of Fleet Data Centers I, LP and proceeds finance construction of a 230 MW turnkey data center and substation on a 252-acre Storey County property; Baxtel says Fleet broke ground within Tract's Peru Shelf Technology Park.
notes: Likely one tenant/build inside Tract's Peru Shelf park; kept separate because financing/abatement records identify a distinct 230 MW facility.

project_name: PR TX 1 LLC Storey County Data Center
aliases: PR TX 1 LLC GOED data center abatement
status_detail: Storey County November 2025 minutes record the Board directing staff to submit a GOED acknowledgement letter for PR TX 1 LLC's data center sales/use and personal property tax abatement application for operations planned in Storey County. GOED board packet says PR TX 1 plans to establish a mega-scale AI/cloud data center operation in Storey County and was approved for abatements.
notes: Developer/operator identity behind PR TX 1 was not resolved in this pass; retained as distinct abatement/application lead.

status_detail: EdgeCore's official Reno data center page says its Reno campus is in Storey County in the Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center and will deliver 216 MW of critical IT load across nearly 1 million sq ft on 56 acres. EdgeCore previously announced construction of its initial metro Reno data center campus.
notes: Some older EdgeCore materials describe north Reno/136 acres and more than 400 MW; current official location page uses Storey County/TRIC and 216 MW, so this row uses the current official campus data.

status_detail: Novva's official Tahoe Reno page locates the facility at 3399 Peru Drive in TRIC. Novva's 2025 release announced the launch of a 300,000 sq ft, 60 MW data center in Storey County on a 20-acre campus; tracker data lists it operational in 2025.
notes: Official location and company release provide project size and capacity.

status_detail: Vantage's official release announced entry into Nevada with NV1, a 224 MW campus in Storey County just outside Reno, with nearly $3 billion investment. Vantage's location page says the campus will have four multi-story facilities in Sparks/Storey County.
notes: Public releases indicate Microsoft involvement/tenant context in reporting, but the official project is Vantage NV1.

project_name: Amazon data center at Switch Citadel
aliases: AWS Switch Citadel Campus Storey County
status_detail: Local KRNV reporting in March 2026 says an Amazon data center project in Storey County had begun hiring, is located at Switch's Citadel Campus at Tahoe Reno Industrial Center, and is expected to create local jobs and tax revenue.
notes: Kept as separate likely tenant/project because local news names Amazon at Switch's Citadel; no official AWS page or MW found in this pass.

project_name: Apple Reno Technology Park Data Center
status_detail: Northern Nevada Business Weekly reported Apple planned to expand its existing data center operations at Reno Technology Park in Washoe County with GOED-approved abatements in 2024. CLUI describes the Apple Reno Data Center as proposed in 2010 and since built/expanded at a cost exceeding $1 billion; tracker data lists a dedicated 100 MW substation.
notes: Capacity reflects tracker-reported substation rather than a confirmed IT load; official county/GOED abatement materials were not fully retrieved in this pass.

status_detail: Data Center Knowledge reported Apple filed with Washoe County for another massive data center campus adjacent to the existing Reno Technology Park facility, codenamed Project Huckleberry, with multiple data center clusters and support building. Earlier DCD reporting cited a Washoe County building permit filing for a 373,000 sq ft data center shell with eight clusters that was withdrawn/resubmittable.
notes: Historical expansion lead; status may have merged into subsequent Apple Reno Technology Park expansion activity.

status_detail: DCD reported Reno granted a business license in 2025 for an existing Lumen data center at 220 Gardner Street that had operated since 1999; public meeting summaries say the Planning Commission approved a conditional use permit for a roughly 6,000 sq ft Lumen facility. Inflect lists Lumen Reno at 220 Gardner Street with 1.6 MW.
notes: Capacity from data center directory; city approval/license evidence from news/meeting summary.

status_detail: Tracker data lists RNO2 as a planned 90,000 sq ft, 12 MW data center in Washoe County being developed by Centra with expected 2026 operation. Regional planning pages confirm Reno-Sparks/Truckee Meadows agencies are actively reviewing data center impacts and policies, but no official project packet was found in this pass.
notes: Low-confidence project row retained to avoid omission; needs permit/source-document follow-up.

status_detail: White Pine County official site and Building Department pages show Resolution 2026-18 imposing a temporary moratorium on accepting, processing, and approving land use applications for data center development. The county agenda material says management officials had discussed proposed data centers but the county had not yet received formal applications.
notes: There is official county data-center policy activity, but no named project or formal application found.

status_detail: City of Albany Planning Board page states the Department of Planning and Development has no application for 451 Southern Boulevard/Kenwood for a data center or any other use as of the July 7, 2026 meeting. Albany Planning Board June 2, 2026 minutes reference a conceptual proposal to locate a data center at Kenwood Commons. Local reporting says EKG Group filed with NYISO for 180 MW and expected 2028 operations.
notes: Official city evidence confirms there was no filed local planning application; capacity/developer from local news/tracker and NYISO queue reporting.

status_detail: Checked Allegany County official website, Allegany County economic development and IDA pages, and web/news searches for data center/server farm/colocation/crypto mining. No reliable Allegany County, NY project found. Search results about the Town of Allegany data center ban refer to Allegany, NY in Cattaraugus County, not Allegany County.
notes: The county has an economic 'Data Center' page meaning data/statistics resources, not a data-center facility.

status_detail: Checked Bronx Borough President official site, NYCEDC pages, NY state county page, local news/searches for Bronx data center/colocation/server farm/NYISO. No reliable Bronx County data center development project found; search results were generic IT service/SEO pages or Manhattan facilities outside Bronx County.
notes: No county/borough-specific project evidence identified.

project_name: Broome Technology Park Data Center Lead
aliases: Broome Technology Park at Airport Road
status_detail: The Agency/Broome County IDA official site says it released a Draft Generic Environmental Impact Statement for the Broome Technology Park and held an April 23, 2026 public hearing for about 537 acres at Airport Road in the towns of Maine and Union. DEC notice describes a sustainability-focused corporate park with technology/manufacturing uses; data-center trackers identify a proposed 250 MW Broome County Tech Park data center lead tied to The Agency.
notes: Official materials confirm the tech park planning/SEQRA process but do not explicitly state the 250 MW data-center use in accessible snippets; capacity/use from tracker, so needs follow-up in DGEIS attachments.

status_detail: WBNG reported in July 2026 that a small data center is currently operating in Building 46 on the Huron Campus and has existed for more than a decade. WNBF reported construction of a Bloom Energy natural gas fuel-cell power facility at Huron Campus to serve a data center; a later WNBF update identified the power facility as 9.36 MW.
notes: Capacity shown is the associated Bloom Energy fuel-cell system capacity, not confirmed data-center IT load. Kept because local officials/news confirm an existing data center.

aliases: NYISO Queue 1723 Olean Digital Data Center
status_detail: Interconnection.fyi NYISO queue record lists Olean Digital Data Center in Cattaraugus County as 300 MW and withdrawn; datacenter.fyi lists it as a cancelled data center developed by Olean Digital LLC on the National Grid grid. County site searches did not surface a local application packet, and later local reporting shows the Town of Allegany in Cattaraugus County adopted a ban on data centers and crypto-mining facilities.
notes: Status mapped to rejected because source status is withdrawn/cancelled; original permit details were not found in quick county search.

project_name: Cayuga County Primary Data Center Relocation
aliases: Auburn Fire Station No. 1 county datacenter relocation
status_detail: Auburn City Council July 17, 2025 official minutes approved an agreement for Cayuga County to lease physical space to relocate the county's primary datacenter, which supports public safety communications, financial systems, document management, employee systems, and other county digital resources, to Auburn Fire Station Number One for $2,480 annually. Local news says the move was prompted by the closed county office building.
notes: Government IT data center relocation rather than a commercial/hyperscale facility. The prominent Cayuga Lake/TeraWulf AI data center proposal is in Lansing, Tompkins County, not Cayuga County.

project_name: Four Winds of Lake Erie / Sugar Hill Data Center
aliases: Sugar Hill Golf Course data center
Four Winds of Lake Erie LLC data center
developer: WEED Inc. / The Four Winds of Lake Erie LLC
status_detail: WEED Inc.'s April 2026 announcement said it planned redevelopment of The Four Winds of Lake Erie LLC, formerly Sugar Hill Golf Course, into a next-generation data center campus on its Lake Erie waterfront property. Local WKBW and Post-Journal reporting say the Portland Town Board gave general approval/support in March 2026, but the town board later clarified there was no formal application or detailed plans yet.
notes: No MW or filed site plan found. Location sources vary between Portland and Westfield postal/address context; project is former Sugar Hill Golf Course along Route 5 in Chautauqua County.
